author: felipeblassioli@gmail.com
abstract: Read-only audit surface of the skill-studio toolkit. Audits a single Claude skill for quality, context-efficiency, and best-practice compliance — classifying its archetype, scoring the four structural principles (single-responsibility, composability, context-efficiency, maintainability) and instruction craft (right altitude / first-run config / earn-the-context / gotchas) — and reviews a portfolio of skills for overlap and trigger collisions. Carries two complementary bundled scripts: skill_hot_path_audit.py (advisory token-economy / hot-path metrics and duplication buckets, character-based) and audit-skill.sh (mechanical package/wiring signals: name/description limits, metadata/CHANGELOG presence, orphan/dangling references, gotchas-section presence, cross-package cache-copy hazards). Diagnoses and recommends only; routes fixes to skill-enhance and repo-governance:skill-maintainer.
